title: Woodcore document template
description: templates/documents/<mode>/<folder>/template.json -- the file that makes a folder a template a new CU, BP or RS document is made from (calc/doc_templates.py) -- a content template, its sections and their text. Beside it, one folder per language (`fr`, `de`, `en`), each **exactly the document's folder**: the entry `.typ` (the only `.typ` at its top), `structure.json` and `Sections/<id>.typ`. Instantiating a template copies the folder of the project's language into the document's folder, renames the entry file to the document's name and rewrites the structure block of the entry from structure.json. A builtin template carries its name and description in all three languages; one the engineer or the office saved from a document (calc/doc_templates.py `save_from_document`, into `documents/<mode>/<folder>/` of the user's or the shared folder of templates) usually in the one language it is written in, which is then the only one it is offered for -- saving the same folder again in another language adds that language. Which languages it has is `languages`, and each has a folder.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a template written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

format.description: What this file is, so a template.json that is something else is refused by name.

mode.description: The document this template makes: cu, the Convention d'utilisation, bp, the Base de projet, or rs, the Rapport de statique. A new project's report is made from its project template (calc/templates.py); a report template is what a report's content is switched to (calc/content_switch.py) or saved as -- its language folders hold the report's entry and its numbered `Sections/NNN-<name>.typ`, and no structure.json.

name.description: The template's name as a list shows it, per language: a key for every language in `languages`.

description.description: What the template is for, per language: a key for every language in `languages`. Optional.

languages.description: The languages the template exists in, each a folder beside this file (`fr/`, `de/`, `en/`). At least one.
